channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Kenya safari helicopter crash: Seven killed including five Americans and Ecuador intelligence chief
item.description: The victims included a senior executive at Telemundo and Ecuador’s national intelligence chief, turning the crash into an international tragedy.

item.title: New CDC Head Apologizes for Staff’s Lack of Psychological Safety
item.description: The new director of the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention told agency employees that she wants them to feel safe and not fear retributions for honest conversations, according to a recording of the meeting heard by Bloomberg News.

item.title: RFK Jr.’s son Conor Kennedy on Russia’s wanted list: Why Moscow wants him arrested
item.description: The Basmanny District Court in Moscow approved an arrest order for the 32-year-old Kennedy in absentia. The charges could carry a prison sentence of seven to 10 years if he is captured.

item.title: US visa expedited appointment pilot: $750 fee for faster B1/B2 interviews; Is India included in the list?
item.description: The Nonimmigrant Visa (NIV) Expedited Appointment Pilot Program, updated on August 18, 2026, is designed to help applicants with urgent travel needs secure an interview within 10 business days, subject to appointment availability.

item.title: H-1B visa holders face new restrictions in Texas as Governor Greg Abbott seeks total ban in public schools
item.description: Abbott announced the proposal during a campaign event in Austin, saying he would ask the Texas Legislature to pass a law imposing a “total ban” on H-1B workers in public schools.

item.title: Quote of the Day by Nobel laureate Nelson Mandela: ‘Do not judge me by my successes…’
item.description: Nelson Mandela's message challenges the traditional measures of success, emphasizing the importance of resilience. Rather than focusing on achievements, he encourages evaluating life through the repeated acts of getting back up after failures.

item.title: Sergio Gor’s J&K remarks trigger Pakistan protest: Islamabad summons US diplomat, cites UNSC resolutions
item.description: Pakistan summoned the US Chargé d’Affaires in Islamabad and lodged a strong protest over US Ambassador Sergio Gor’s remarks in Srinagar describing Jammu and Kashmir as an 'important part of India'.

item.title: Why did a man in dog costume walk into MP's Khandwa collectorate office? ‘Children are afraid to go to school’
item.description: Mullu Rathore attended a public hearing with a man in a dog mask to highlight stray dog attacks and alleged irregularities in the sterilisation programme in Madhya Pradesh.&nbsp;

item.title: H-1B visa delay relief? Telangana CM urges US Ambassador for faster processing, easier renewals, more appointment slots
item.description: During a 30-minute meeting with Gor, Reddy highlighted concerns faced by Telangana residents travelling to the US for work and higher education. He also sought faster processing of visa applications and more interview slots to prevent delays.

item.title: From ₹2.4 LPA to ₹14 LPA in 6 years: IT professional’s salary jump goes viral; social media debates over job strategies
item.description: Nandini M's salary journey from ₹2.40 LPA in 2020 to ₹14 LPA in 2026 emphasises career mobility in India's tech sector, sparking discussions on job loyalty and growth strategies among professionals.

item.title: Deputy governor Murmu asks banks to stress-test AI systems before deployment
item.description: The RBI deputy governor pointed to MuleHunter.ai and the Digital Payments Intelligence Platform as the central bank's response to fraud that moves across multiple accounts and intermediaries simultaneously.

item.title: Cabinet clears ₹13,041 crore rail, highway projects
item.description: Four rail projects will add 410 km to the network across West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh, while a four-lane highway in Bihar will cut travel time between Muzaffarpur and Sonbarsa.

item.title: Queen Camilla reveals struggle to hide King Charles’ cancer: ‘I was just longing to let it out’
item.description: Camilla recalled visiting a Maggie’s cancer support centre shortly after Charles was diagnosed, saying she was “longing to let it out” but knew it was not the right time to disclose the news.

item.title: Hind Rajab killing: IDF fired on 5-year-old’s car in Gaza, Israel admits for first time, orders probe
item.description: Hind Rajab's body was recovered from a car riddled with bullets in Gaza City days after she was last heard from in a desperate, hours-long phone call to the Palestinian Red Crescent on January 29, 2024. The Israeli military had previously denied its troops were present in the area near the incident

item.title: UnitedHealth faces IRS fight over foreign subsidiary transactions and potential tax bill
item.description: The IRS is seeking to increase UnitedHealth’s taxable income over foreign subsidiary transactions as the healthcare giant contests the proposed tax adjustments.

item.title: Who is David Morens? Fauci’s former adviser admits to concealing COVID research records
item.description: The 78-year-old entered his guilty plea Tuesday in federal court in Greenbelt, Maryland. He is scheduled to be sentenced on November 12 and faces a maximum sentence of five years in prison.

item.title: India’s ₹1 trillion RDI fund to select next set of fund managers in a ‘couple of weeks’
item.description: Selection for the government's ₹1 trillion Research, Development and Innovation fund will be merit-based with no fixed cap on numbers, RDI Cell head Jyoti Sharma told Mint.

item.title: Woman shares daughter's school fee breakdown: ₹14 lakh tuition, bus, food cost extra
item.description: Transport is charged separately, according to Veronika. She said the school bus costs about ₹3.12 lakh &nbsp;annually and collects children from their homes before taking them back after school.

item.title: US-Iran tensions escalate: Trump rules out talks, UAE halts Iran trade, Tehran warns Gulf allies | Latest developments
item.description: UAE halts trade with Tehran after missile strikes, and Iran warns Gulf states against supporting US forces. Meanwhile, Strait of Hormuz shipping remains severely disrupted, keeping oil prices elevated - Latest developments

item.title: Not impressed with a political post on X? Elon Musk’s social media platform may show you more of those, says new study
item.description: A new study reveals X's algorithm operates through 'hate management', prioritising engagement over user values.&nbsp;

item.title: West Bengal teen's desperate search for relief kept him in ponds, then Anant Ambani stepped in
item.description: A young boy from West Bengal's Murshidabad, who had been living in a pond due to a debilitating medical condition, has been airlifted to Mumbai for specialised medical evaluation and treatment following intervention by Anant Ambani.

item.title: Israel pre-election survey: Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar leads Netanyahu’s Likud
item.description: Netanyahu’s current coalition is projected to win 52 seats, while opposition parties would secure 57 seats.

item.title: ‘Mera baap kaun hai’: Omar Abdullah says Gen Z goodwill is at stake, reacts to viral video
item.description: The controversy erupted over a viral video of a female tourist at a checkpoint, in which she voiced frustration with the treatment of tourists and locals.&nbsp;

item.title: Did Neutrogena sack Hayden Panettiere over ‘postpartum depression’ remark? Boycott calls grow after death
item.description: Panettiere had appeared in multiple Neutrogena campaigns and served as a brand ambassador before the partnership came to an end in 2016.

item.title: IndiGo flyers alert! Unable to book tickets, check-in? Airlines reports reservation platform issues: What you can do
item.description: IndiGo, said on Wednesday (18 August) that it was facing intermittent problems with its core reservation system, leaving some passengers unable to book flights or complete online check-in.

item.title: Delhi Tragedy: Death toll climbs to three after gas tank explodes at CNG station in Tikri Kalan
item.description: CNG Gas tank explosion: The Delhi Fire Service received a call about the incident at 3.37 pm, following which six fire tenders were sent to the site. The injured people, who were reportedly near the truck when the explosion occurred, were taken to a nearby hospital for treatment.

item.title: TMC MP Mahua Moitra in trouble? Bengal court issues arrest warrant in hate speech case
item.description: The Judge had on Tuesday (18 August) directed the TMC MP to appear before the court the next day, but noted that she was not present.

item.title: US envoy Sergio Gor hints at ‘downgrading’ travel advisory for J&K after meeting CM Omar Abdullah
item.description: US Ambassador Sergio Gor met Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah and discussed the potential downgrading of the travel advisory for the region, highlighting its beauty and improved safety measures.&nbsp;

item.title: Monthly rent was ₹21: Vedanta founder Anil Agarwal remembers his humble beginning, ‘seasons passed’ in 8x9 office
item.description: Founder Anil Agarwal reminisces about his first office in Mumbai's Kalbadevi in 1975. With little money and immense determination, he transformed his initial challenges into opportunities.

item.title: SC gets EOW report finding no direct link between IHFL loans, Gehlaut-linked entities in key cases
item.description: A Delhi Police Economic Offences Wing (EOW) status report filed before the Supreme Court has said that its investigation so far has not found a direct financial link between loans disbursed by IHFL and investments made in entities associated with its former promoter, Sameer Gehlaut.

item.title: Quote of the day by Maya Angelou: ‘If you are always trying to be normal, you will never know…’
item.description: Quote of the day is by Maya Angelou, where she encourages everyone to live life to their fullest without forcing themselves into society's idea of perfection. Here's why it is important in today's time.

item.title: Kala Hiran teaser row: Producer Amit Jani moves Supreme Court against Delhi HC order
item.description: The Delhi High Court has in an interim order directed the removal of a teaser for the film ‘Kala Hiran: The Battle for Legal’, purportedly based on actor Salman Khan

item.title: TVK MLA croons MGR's hit song Kodutthathellam Kodutthan after Vijay announces govt vehicles for MLAs. Watch
item.description: CM Vijay struggled to control smile after TVK MLA K Sindhu's musical tribute. It arrived after he made a series of announcement at the Assembly today, including milk procurement prices, medical education, healthcare and more.

item.title: Iran may target US assets in Europe if Trump escalates war: What are the potential targets? Report reveals...
item.description: Two regime insiders reportedly stated that Iranian forces have assessed potential strikes on US assets in southeastern European countries, including Bulgaria, which last month approved the use of its Bezmer air base by US refuelling aircraft.

item.title: Sitharaman, Goyal in Singapore with 70-strong business delegation for 4th ministerial roundtable
item.description: Union ministers and top industry leaders are visiting Singapore to review economic ties across key pillars, drive investment, and explore new business partnerships at the 4th India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable.
